import json import ipaddress import re import html as html_lib from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta # ============================================================ # 0. YOUR SETTINGS (edit these, nothing else needs touching) # ============================================================ # IRIS severity ids. Check them in your IRIS: in your last run id 4 came back # named "Low", so confirm which ids mean Medium and High on your instance. SEVERITY_IDS = {"MEDIUM": 4, "HIGH": 5} # Small asset knowledge so the alert can say what the source and target are. KNOWN_SOURCES = { "172.16.220.1": "VirtualBox host-only gateway (lab)", } ASSETS = { "Webserveur": {"env": "lab", "criticality": "low"}, } MITRE = { "100100": "T1110.001 Password Guessing", "100102": "T1110.001 Password Guessing, then T1078 Valid Accounts", } # ============================================================ # 1. READ INPUTS (the only lines Shuffle fills in) # ============================================================ data_text = r'''$exec.all_fields.data''' ai_text = r'''$http_1.body.message.content''' rule_id = str(r'''$exec.rule_id''').strip() raw_host = str(r'''$exec.all_fields.agent.name''').strip() raw_timestamp = str(r'''$exec.timestamp''').strip() event_id = str(r'''$exec.id''').strip() agent_id = str(r'''$exec.all_fields.agent.id''').strip() previous_output = str(r'''$exec.all_fields.previous_output''').strip() current_log = str(r'''$exec.text''').strip() # OPTIONAL: number of "authentication success" events from this source that a # Wazuh search node found. There is no such node yet, so this is empty and the # alert says NOT CHECKED. Once you add the search node and connect it BEFORE this # node, set login_hits_raw to the total hits value from that node's response # (written in the same r-triple-quote style as the inputs above). login_hits_raw = "" try: data = json.loads(data_text) except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError): data = {} if not isinstance(data, dict): data = {} try: ai = json.loads(ai_text.strip()) except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, AttributeError): ai = {} if not isinstance(ai, dict): ai = {} # ============================================================ # 2. HELPERS # ============================================================ DOLLAR = chr(36) # written this way so Shuffle never tries to substitute it NL = chr(92) + "n" # backslash + n: becomes a real line break inside the IRIS JSON body MONTHS = {m: i for i, m in enumerate( ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"], 1)} LOG_TIME = re.compile( r"\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)\s+(\d{1,2})\s+(\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})\b" ) def clean_text(value, limit=500, keep_ticks=False): # One-line, JSON-safe, markdown-safe text (usernames and logs are attacker-controlled). # keep_ticks=True is only for our own sentences, whose untrusted parts were already # cleaned (backticks removed) before being placed between our inline-code backticks. value = str(value) value = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]", " ", value) value = value.replace("\\", "/").replace('"', "'") if not keep_ticks: value = value.replace("`", "'") value = " ".join(value.split()) return value[:limit] def cell(value, limit=200): # Same as clean_text, but also safe inside a markdown table cell return clean_text(value, limit).replace("|", "/") def esc(value, limit=300): # Safe to drop into the HTML email: tags are escaped, and the dollar sign is # written as an HTML entity so Shuffle can never treat it as a variable. text = html_lib.escape(clean_text(value, limit), quote=True) return text.replace(chr(36), "$") def evidence_html(prev, cur): # Last few log lines, each escaped, separated by line breaks lines = [] for part in (prev, cur): part = str(part).strip() if part and not part.startswith(chr(36) + "exec"): lines += [line for line in part.splitlines() if line.strip()] if not lines: return "No log evidence was available to the workflow." return "
".join(esc(line, 300) for line in lines[-6:]) def clean_lines(value, max_lines=15, line_limit=300): # Keeps the line structure of a multi-line log, each line cleaned lines = [clean_text(line, line_limit) for line in str(value).splitlines()] lines = [line for line in lines if line] if len(lines) > max_lines: extra = len(lines) - max_lines lines = lines[:max_lines] + [f"... ({extra} more lines)"] return NL.join(lines) def is_unfilled(value): # Shuffle leaves the variable text behind when it cannot fill a value return (not value) or (DOLLAR in value) def parse_event_time(raw): # Wazuh sends 2026-10-17T13:10:13.304+0000. Older Python versions cannot read # the +0000 offset (no colon). Normalise first, then fall back to the current # time so the field sent to IRIS is never empty. text = str(raw).strip() if text and DOLLAR not in text: if text.endswith("Z"): text = text[:-1] + "+00:00" text = re.sub(r"([+-]\d{2})(\d{2})\Z", r"\1:\2", text) text = re.sub(r"(\.\d+)", lambda m: (m.group(1) + "000000")[:7], text, count=1) try: parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text) if parsed.tzinfo is None: parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), True except ValueError: pass return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), False def log_times(text, year): # Pulls syslog-style times (Oct 17 16:37:50) out of the evidence found = set() for mon, day, hh, mm, ss in LOG_TIME.findall(text): try: found.add(datetime(year, MONTHS[mon], int(day), int(hh), int(mm), int(ss))) except ValueError: pass return sorted(found) # ============================================================ # 3. EXTRACT AND CLEAN THE FACTS # ============================================================ raw_ip = str(data.get("srcip", "")).strip() raw_user = str(data.get("dstuser", "")).strip() try: srcip = str(ipaddress.ip_address(raw_ip)) ip_valid = True except (ValueError, TypeError): srcip = "" ip_valid = False if ip_valid: is_internal = ipaddress.ip_address(srcip).is_private ip_kind = "internal address" if is_internal else "external address" else: is_internal = False ip_kind = "unknown address" ip_text = srcip if ip_valid else "UNKNOWN" dstuser = clean_text(raw_user, 128) user = clean_text(raw_user, 64) or "UNKNOWN" if is_unfilled(raw_host): host = "UNKNOWN" else: host = clean_text(raw_host, 64) agent_text = "UNKNOWN" if is_unfilled(agent_id) else clean_text(agent_id, 32) event_id_text = "UNKNOWN" if is_unfilled(event_id) else clean_text(event_id, 60) # The username is attacker-controlled (failed logins can use any name). # Only put it inside a shell command when it looks like a normal Linux username. if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]{0,31}", raw_user): user_cmd = raw_user else: user_cmd = "USERNAME" event_time, event_time_ok = parse_event_time(raw_timestamp) event_dt = datetime.strptime(event_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") # UTC, naive now_dt = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) # Attempt timing, read from the log lines themselves (nothing is guessed) evidence_text = "" # For rule 100102 the current log line is the successful login, not a failed attempt timing_sources = (previous_output,) if rule_id == "100102" else (previous_output, current_log) for part in timing_sources: if part and DOLLAR not in part: evidence_text += " " + part times = log_times(evidence_text, event_dt.year) tz_label = "UTC" if times and abs((times[-1] - event_dt).total_seconds()) > 300: tz_label = "host time" # log clock does not match the Wazuh clock pattern_text = "" if len(times) >= 3: gaps = [(b - a).total_seconds() for a, b in zip(times, times[1:])] if max(gaps) - min(gaps) <= 1: pattern_text = "evenly spaced, consistent with a script" else: pattern_text = "irregular spacing" # Did a login succeed? Only claim what was actually checked. login_hits = None if login_hits_raw and DOLLAR not in login_hits_raw and login_hits_raw.isdigit(): login_hits = int(login_hits_raw) if rule_id == "100102": login_state = "yes" elif login_hits is None: login_state = "not_checked" else: login_state = "yes" if login_hits > 0 else "no" if times and tz_label == "UTC": window_start = times[0] else: window_start = event_dt - timedelta(seconds=60) window_text = f"{window_start:%H:%M}-{now_dt:%H:%M}" checked_text = f"checked {now_dt:%H:%M} UTC, window {window_text}" if rule_id == "100102": login_line = "YES (Wazuh rule 100102 fired: success right after repeated failures)" elif login_state == "no": login_line = f"NO ({checked_text})" elif login_state == "yes": login_line = f"YES ({login_hits} authentication success event(s) from this source, {checked_text})" else: login_line = ( "NOT CHECKED (no Wazuh search result reached this script, " "so a successful login cannot be ruled out)" ) # ============================================================ # 4. AI SUMMARY (kept as a field for other nodes, not shown in the alert) # ============================================================ raw_summary = ai.get("summary") ai_valid = isinstance(raw_summary, str) and bool(raw_summary.strip()) ai_summary = clean_text(raw_summary, 400) if ai_valid else "AI summary unavailable." # ============================================================ # 5. DECISIONS COME FROM THE WAZUH RULE, NOT FROM THE MODEL # ============================================================ known_source = KNOWN_SOURCES.get(ip_text, "") asset = ASSETS.get(host, {}) steps = [] if rule_id == "100100": severity_name = "MEDIUM" label = "SSH brute-force attempt" verdict = "brute_force" tags = "wazuh,ssh,brute-force,rule-100100" rule_line = "100100, SSH brute-force (5 fails / 60s)" attempts_n = "5" if login_state == "yes": assessment = ( f"Failed logins from {ip_text} were followed by a successful login from " "the same source. Treat as possible account compromise until verified." ) decision = ( f"Confirm with the owner of '{user}' whether this login was theirs. " "If not confirmed, contain the account and block the source." ) elif ip_valid and is_internal: if login_state == "no": assessment = ( f"Low-volume failures from an internal address, no successful login " f"found at check time. Likely test activity or a misconfigured script, " f"but the real origin behind {ip_text} is not identified." ) else: assessment = ( f"Failures from an internal address. Whether a login succeeded was not " f"checked, so compromise cannot be ruled out from this alert alone. " f"The real origin behind {ip_text} is not identified." ) decision = ( f"Identify who or what is behind {ip_text}. If unknown, escalate. " "If a known lab test, close as benign true positive." ) elif ip_valid: assessment = ( f"Failures from an external address. " + ("No successful login found at check time." if login_state == "no" else "Whether a login succeeded was not checked.") ) decision = ( f"Block {ip_text} at the firewall or with fail2ban unless it is a known host, " f"and confirm '{user}' is an expected account." ) else: assessment = "The source address could not be read from the alert." decision = "Identify the source of the attempts from the original Wazuh alert." elif rule_id == "100102": severity_name = "HIGH" label = "SSH login succeeded after brute force" verdict = "successful_login_after_bruteforce" tags = "wazuh,ssh,successful-login,brute-force,rule-100102" rule_line = "100102, SSH login succeeded right after repeated failures" attempts_n = "5" assessment = ( "Possible account compromise, not confirmed. " "Treat as real until the login is verified." ) decision = ( f"Confirm with the owner of '{user}' whether they logged in from {ip_text} at this time." ) steps = [ f"If not confirmed, contain it on `{host}`: `sudo usermod -L -e 1 {user_cmd}` " f"then `sudo pkill -KILL -u {user_cmd}`, and block `{ip_text}`.", f"Review what the session did: `last -a {user_cmd}`, shell history, " "`~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, cron jobs, new users or sudo changes. Reset the password.", "If it was legitimate: close the alert as a false positive and move SSH to key-only login.", ] else: severity_name = "MEDIUM" label = "Wazuh SSH alert" verdict = "unknown" tags = "wazuh,ssh" rule_line = f"{clean_text(rule_id, 20)}, not classified by this workflow" attempts_n = "" assessment = "Not classified by this workflow." decision = "Open the original alert in Wazuh and review the evidence." severity = SEVERITY_IDS.get(severity_name, 4) if login_state == "not_checked": confidence = "Low" else: confidence = "Medium" # ============================================================ # 6. BUILD THE IRIS ALERT (markdown) # ============================================================ alert_title = clean_text(f"{label}: {user} from {ip_text} on {host}", 200) if attempts_n: attempts_text = f"{attempts_n} failed (rule threshold)" else: attempts_text = "unknown" if len(times) >= 2: attempts_text += f", first {times[0]:%H:%M:%S}, last {times[-1]:%H:%M:%S} {tz_label}" elif len(times) == 1: attempts_text += f", last {times[0]:%H:%M:%S} {tz_label}" if pattern_text: attempts_text += f", pattern: {pattern_text}" source_text = f"{ip_text}, {ip_kind}" source_text += f", {known_source}" if known_source else ", owner not identified" target_text = f"{host} (agent {agent_text})" if asset: target_text += f", env: {asset.get('env', 'unknown')}, criticality: {asset.get('criticality', 'unknown')}" event_time_display = event_time.replace("T", " ") + " UTC" if not event_time_ok: event_time_display += " (alert time, Wazuh timestamp unreadable)" facts = [ ("Rule", cell(rule_line, 120)), ("MITRE", cell(MITRE.get(rule_id, "not mapped"), 120)), ("Attempts", cell(attempts_text, 250)), ("Account", cell(user, 64)), ("Source", cell(source_text, 200)), ("Target", cell(target_text, 200)), ("Event time", event_time_display), ] facts_table = NL.join( ["| Field | Value |", "|---|---|"] + [f"| {k} | {v} |" for k, v in facts] ) blocks = [ f"**Verdict:** {severity_name} | Confidence: {confidence} | Status: Needs review", "**Login success after failures:** " + clean_text(login_line, 300), facts_table, "**Assessment:** " + clean_text(assessment, 500), "**Decision needed:** " + clean_text(decision, 400), ] if steps: blocks.append( "**Next steps:**" + NL + NL.join( f"{i}. {clean_text(s, 400, keep_ticks=True)}" for i, s in enumerate(steps, 1) ) ) blocks.append(f"**Evidence:** Wazuh event ID {event_id_text}, raw logs in the alert note.") alert_description = (NL + NL).join(blocks) # One-line version (handy for emails or chat) alert_summary = clean_text( f"[{severity_name}] {label} | {user} from {ip_text} on {host} | " f"login success: {login_state.replace('_', ' ')}", 400 ) # Evidence goes in the IRIS alert note, with the log lines kept on separate lines fence = chr(96) * 3 note_blocks = ["### Evidence"] if previous_output and DOLLAR not in previous_output: note_blocks.append( "**Previous failed attempts**" + NL + fence + NL + clean_lines(previous_output) + NL + fence ) if current_log and DOLLAR not in current_log: note_blocks.append( "**Triggering log line**" + NL + fence + NL + clean_lines(current_log, max_lines=5, line_limit=500) + NL + fence ) if len(note_blocks) == 1: note_blocks.append("No log evidence was available to the workflow.") alert_note = (NL + NL).join(note_blocks) source_ref = ( f"wazuh-{event_id_text}" if event_id_text != "UNKNOWN" else f"wazuh-{clean_text(rule_id, 20)}-{ip_text}-{event_time}" ) evidence = clean_text( f"Previous failed-attempt evidence: {previous_output} | " f"Current log: {current_log}", 2000 ) # Fields for the analyst email (all HTML-escaped, prefixed e_) login_short = {"yes": "YES", "no": "NO", "not_checked": "NOT CHECKED"}[login_state] email_fields = { "e_title": esc(alert_title, 200), "e_severity": esc(severity_name, 20), "e_confidence": esc(confidence, 20), "e_login_short": esc(login_short, 20), "e_login": esc(login_line, 300), "e_rule": esc(rule_line, 120), "e_mitre": esc(MITRE.get(rule_id, "not mapped"), 120), "e_attempts": esc(attempts_text, 250), "e_account": esc(user, 64), "e_host": esc(host, 64), "e_source": esc(source_text, 200), "e_target": esc(target_text, 200), "e_event_time": esc(event_time_display, 100), "e_assessment": esc(assessment, 500), "e_decision": esc(decision, 400), "e_evidence": evidence_html(previous_output, current_log), } # ============================================================ # 7. RETURN RESULTS TO SHUFFLE # ============================================================ result = { "srcip": srcip, "dstuser": dstuser, "host": host, "ip_valid": ip_valid, "verdict": verdict, "severity": severity, "login_state": login_state, "ai_valid": ai_valid, "ai_summary": ai_summary, "alert_title": alert_title, "alert_description": alert_description, "alert_note": alert_note, "alert_summary": alert_summary, "tags": tags, "event_time": event_time, "source_ref": source_ref, "agent_id": agent_id, "evidence": evidence, } result.update(email_fields) print(json.dumps(result))
